integrity: The proof is analytic/topological. The exact date field uses the first-public arXiv timestamp of the dated source anchor; older comparison literature is cited without replacing unknown first-public days by journal dates. One highly relevant 2000 paper was compared through its abstract and through a later full-text paper describing its scope, but its own full text was not materially available.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to planar constant-width bodies and is almost-everywhere only; it neither solves the parity-measure problem for arbitrary convex bodies nor controls the exceptional null set.
title: Odd affine-diameter multiplicity almost everywhere for every planar body of constant width
